hints: resolve-skills suggests catalog skills that fit a request. Run it with execute and pass the input JSON on stdin through a quoted heredoc: resolve-skills <<'JSON', then one line {"message": "<the request>", "session_id": "<this thread>", "harness": "qm", "top_k": 5}, then JSON. It prints one JSON object; its block names the skills to open with skills action read, and an empty block means none fit.
